README_STATUS: The repository now contains a host-first compiler/SDK layer as well as the CUDA numerical execution substrate, typed biological identities, geometry preparation, and bounded source/native relation-update paths. Optional CelleraTorch integration and several historical backends coexist. These are useful implemented components, not proof that the whole target language, general learning path or adaptive execution model is finished.
README_RESULTS: One verified historical study shows a narrow N=64 exact-cover hybrid win at reuse 1 and 16 on the reported V100 fixture; the [result page](docs/results/ce-exact-cover.md) states the comparison, source and limits. It is not a universal layout or biological-performance claim.
PROJECT_AGENT_INVARIANTS:
- Preserve biological domain/order identity and distinguish immutable structure epochs from mutable value generations.

BUILD_COMMANDS:
```sh
# Host compiler/SDK only, not the complete GPU runtime.
cmake -S . -B build-docs-host -DCELLERATOR_ENABLE_CUDA=OFF
cmake --build build-docs-host --target cellerator celleratord -j 4
# Native accelerator configuration using the configured local toolchain.
cmake -S . -B build-docs-cuda -DCELLERATOR_ENABLE_CUDA=ON
cmake --build build-docs-cuda --target abiRuntimeTest -j 4
./build-docs-cuda/abiRuntimeTest
```

The host SDK build alone does not provide all runtime components required by GlassHelix. Its consumer path requires a qualified Cellerator package with native-foundation components. Torch is optional and configured separately. Use a project-local install prefix when testing package consumers.
STATUS_IMPLEMENTED: The source tree contains a host-first compiler/SDK route and a separately configured CUDA numerical runtime. It also contains typed biological identities, geometry preparation, prepared numerical operations, a bounded native/source relation-update path, and an optional CelleraTorch adapter. The Relation Update Spine v1 record bounds one prepared relation to N1/N16 routes and preserves larger compiler/runtime goals as unfinished. These facilities do not establish complete language coverage, general training, or a complete adaptive execution system.
